description: This file defines an interface 'JsonNull' used to represent JSON null values within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.json' package.

classes.name: JsonNull
classes.description: An interface to represent JSON null values, extending JsonValue, with default methods for writing to serialization context and estimating string size.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Default method to write a null value to the provided serialization context.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum string size for the JSON null representation, which is 4 ('null').
